DDInter271.mechanism: INTERVAL: Coadministration with antacids may decrease the bioavailability of oral cabotegravir. The proposed mechanism likely involves a pH-dependent reduction in dissolution and absorption of cabotegravir, which is poorly soluble over a wide pH range. The interaction has not been studied specifically with antacids.
